title: MJ-12 documents surface in 1984, sent from near Kirtland
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: documents, so they they first appeared in uh 1984, they were probably sent from somewhere near Kirtland Air Force Base.

related.note: Both are about how the first MJ-12 documents reached Shandera and Moore in the 1980s. This telling says they were probably sent from near Kirtland, in Doty's orbit; the story says DIA's Falcon passed on film made by Angleton's chop shop.

plain: A set of papers known as the MJ-12 documents, said to describe a secret group of officials handling UFO matters, first turned up in 1984 and were probably mailed from somewhere near Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico. The researcher Richard Dolan says this on Jesse Michels's show, summarising it without naming a source. If he is right, it would point to the papers coming from people close to a military base rather than from an outsider.
